purpose: Teach: フェニックス/ユビキタス/フェデラー/バレンシア/ルックス/ゴッホ/スタンフォード大/寝たきり

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフェニックスの神話の本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going to read you a book about the Phoenix myth.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Soft opening. The pleased tone of someone sharing something she knows he'll like. Unhurried, with quiet affection underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとユビキタス時代のお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I told Dad about that story of ubiquitous times.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice with the specific pride of a six-year-old sharing something he learned. Quick delivery. A small laugh underneath — pleased with himself but not showing off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフェデラー選手の試合を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a Federer match earlier.
lines.style: Observant, gentle recollection. Slightly wistful tone — noticing something small he did. Slow pace, unhurried. A slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとバレンシアのオレンジを食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I had Valencia oranges with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. The simple joy of a shared memory with his father. Quick words tumbling out. Small, genuine happiness in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルックスより中身を大事にしようって仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said something about how what's inside matters more than looks.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Gentle emphasis on the weight of what was said. Slow enough that the idea lands. A quiet approval underneath — this is something she values too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゴッホの展覧会行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go see a Van Gogh exhibition with Dad.
lines.style: Bright wish, stated with certainty and hope. The openness of a child asking for something he really wants. Eager but not demanding. Soft rise at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスタンフォード大のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told you about Stanford University.
lines.style: Observant recall. Gentle, unhurried. The tone of someone noticing and remembering what her son's father shares. Quiet pride in the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが寝たきりにならないようにお祈りしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I prayed that Grandpa won't have to stay in bed.
lines.style: Quiet, tender seriousness. A six-year-old's careful words about something that worries him. Soft delivery, no performance. The weight of what matters to him, held gently.
